+"""Order queries."""
+
+
+def find_orders(conn, customer_id, status):
+    cur = conn.execute(
+        "SELECT id, total FROM orders WHERE customer_id = %s AND status = %s",
+        (customer_id, status),
+    )
+    return cur.fetchall()
